notes: Built-in pronunciation rules of the Voiceover section (see docs/Voiceover.md). Each rule was measured against speech recognition (8 takes per context): the engine garbled the word in its normal spelling and read the replacement more often. match is lower case; kind 'word' matches the whole word, 'stem' the beginning of a word and keeps its ending; the capital letter is kept unless keep_case is false. A rule without engines applies to all of them.
